name: Jadefire Run
summary: Jadefire Run shelters Felwood’s strongest and most cunning satyrs in the north. Their fortified camp spreads demonic corruption through the tainted woods.

sections.title: A Bastion of Deceit
sections.body: In northern Felwood, Jadefire satyrs hold a stronghold among the blighted woods. Demonic structures shelter formidable spellcasters and tricksters, far stronger than those in the valley’s lesser outposts. The satyrs use dark sorcery and foul trickery against anyone who enters their territory. They seek to spread corruption farther across Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Jadefire Run is a major satyr settlement in northern Felwood. It shelters some of the forest’s most dangerous and elite satyrs.

faq.q: Who rules or lives in Jadefire Run?
faq.answer: Jadefire Run is home to the Jadefire satyrs, corrupted servants of the Burning Legion. They use fel magic and deceptive illusions to terrorize the surrounding forest.

faq.q: Why is Jadefire Run so dangerous?
faq.answer: The satyrs of Jadefire Run are stronger and more organized than those in southern Felwood. Their demonic structures and potent spellcasters make them dangerous to the unprepared.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see Jadefire Run as a reminder of ancient betrayal and demonic defilement on Kalimdor’s sacred soil. It must be cleansed.
As a druid, you see Jadefire Run’s vile rituals and fel presence as an open wound poisoning Felwood’s natural spirits.
